letters.title: Open When...
letters.subtitle: Six digital envelopes sealed with love. Open them whenever your heart needs a reminder of who is always in your corner.
letters.keepersNote: “Whenever the world feels loud or you forget how extraordinary you are, come back here. Each envelope is yours forever.”

envelopes.title: Open when you miss me
envelopes.summary: Take a deep breath and look at the screen... I am probably already thinking of you right this second.
envelopes.quote: “Take a deep breath and look at the screen...”
envelopes.body: I am probably already thinking of you right this second. Even if distance exists today, every good thing I see reminds me of your smile or some absurd little joke we cracked at 2 AM. If you still miss me after reading this, text me this exact emoji: 🌙 (I will answer instantly, guaranteed).

envelopes.title: Open when you're sad
envelopes.summary: Sealed until your sky looks a little cloudy. Contains five undeniable truths about how strong, gentle, and utterly cherished you are.
envelopes.quote: “You don't always have to be resilient...”
envelopes.body: It is completely okay if today feels heavy. Please remember that you don't carry the weight of everything by yourself. I love the quiet days, the messy days, and every shadow in between just as fiercely as the sunny ones. A big, warm hug is waiting for you anytime.

envelopes.title: Open when you need a laugh
envelopes.summary: A classified compendium of our most ridiculous inside jokes, voice note quotes, and clumsy moments where we laughed until our stomachs ached.
envelopes.body: Remember when we tried to look so poised and sophisticated, only for powdered sugar to shoot into my nostril from laughing at your face? That snort of yours is my favorite soundtrack on earth. Never stop laughing like that.

envelopes.title: Open when you can't sleep
envelopes.summary: A calming bedtime meditation letter to quiet your whirling racing thoughts. Close your eyes, breathe, and count soft starlight steps with me.
envelopes.body: You have done enough today. Let your thoughts settle like warm tea. Imagine my hand holding yours while the universe quietly watches over your sweet dreams. You are safe, you are protected, and you are loved. Dream beautifully, my darling.

envelopes.title: Open when you're stressed
envelopes.summary: When assignments, deadlines, or expectations start piling up. A grounded reality check on how brilliant you are when you take it one breath at a time.
envelopes.quote: “Drop your shoulders and unclench your jaw right now.”
envelopes.body: You do not have to conquer everything before sundown. Grades, projects, and chaos are small blips in our lifetime of joy. You are already extraordinary, and I believe in your magic even when you feel tired. One step at a time. I've got you.

envelopes.title: Open when you turn 21
envelopes.summary: Unlocks 30.10.2027 · A whole year of Level 20 adventures awaits first. Sealed with a promise and an unwritten chapter.
envelopes.body: This vault remains locked until 30 October 2027. Swayam will hand over the key on your 21st birthday!

reasons20.title: 20 Reasons Why
reasons20.subtitle: Twenty little things that make you the most extraordinary person I know. Tap each card to unveil the memory.

reasons.text: The way you scrunch your nose when laughing uncontrollably
Your endless empathy and baby talk for every stray cat we pass
Your midnight tea rituals and soft quiet hums while waiting for water to boil
How your warm hug instantly silences all my doubts and anxiety
The way your eyes dance whenever you spot a vintage bookstore window
Singing completely off-key with total confidence to our roadtrip playlists
How you make 3 AM conversations feel like uncovering secrets of the universe
The way you fiercely protect the people you love with your whole heart
Your adorable sleepy voice when you pick up the phone first thing in the morning
Ordering dessert first because 'life is too short to wait for sugar'
The pride and quiet glow on your face when you master something hard
How you remember tiny passing details I mentioned weeks ago
Your infectious laugh that turns any gloomy rainy room into pure sunshine
How safe and grounded my entire soul feels whenever my hand is in yours
Your fierce curiosity about the world, the stars, and how things work
The funny faces you pull when you're deeply concentrating on something
The way you listen with your whole being, never just waiting for your turn to speak
How you look in my oversized hoodies, pulling the sleeves over your hands
Your unwavering belief in me even when I struggled to believe in myself
Simply because you are Isha—my once-in-a-lifetime person, today and for all chapters ahead

finale.letterParagraph2: Thank you for being my anchor, my favorite chaos, and my dream come true. Level 20 is just the beginning of your greatest adventure yet.
finale.letterParagraph3: Every moment with you feels like discovering a secret constellation meant only for us. Here is to all our chapters ahead.
